raw_passes.answer: If you work remotely, you must receive manager approval before changing your regular work location, with temporary changes within the same country for fewer than 15 business days approved by the manager and longer changes requiring People Operations review. Remote work must follow the Device and BYOD Security Policy and the Data Classification and Handling Policy. Confidential and restricted data may only be accessed on approved devices using company-approved tools. Personal devices may be used for limited work access only when enrolled in approved mobile device management or when access occurs through approved browser-based tools, must use a passcode, supported operating system, and automatic lock, and restricted data must not be downloaded to personal devices. Employees who regularly access company systems should use a company-managed device with disk encryption, endpoint protection, automatic screen lock, and current operating system updates, and must not disable security tools or remove device management controls. Remote workers are responsible for using secure networks, avoiding shared public computers, and protecting screens from unauthorized viewing.

raw_passes.question: Pull the complete answer together across every applicable policy: if I work remotely, what approval and device security expectations apply?
raw_passes.answer: If you work remotely, you must receive manager approval before changing your regular work location. Temporary changes within the same country for fewer than 15 business days may be approved by the manager, but longer changes require People Operations review. Remote work must follow the Device and BYOD Security Policy and the Data Classification and Handling Policy. Confidential and restricted data may only be accessed on approved devices using company-approved tools. Personal devices may be used for limited work access only when enrolled in approved mobile device management or when access occurs through approved browser-based tools, and must use a passcode, supported operating system, and automatic lock. Restricted data must not be downloaded to personal devices, and confidential data should be accessed only through approved company systems. Employees who regularly access company systems should use a company-managed device with disk encryption, endpoint protection, automatic screen lock, and current operating system updates. Employees may not disable security tools or remove device management controls from company devices. Additionally, remote employees are responsible for using secure networks, avoiding shared public computers, and protecting screens from unauthorized viewing.
